title: Sean Tucker Might Offer Flex Value
description: Tampa Bay Buccaneers running back Sean Tucker has seen an increased role in the offense over the last few games. Last week, Tucker rushed nine times for 53 yards during the loss to the New England Patriots. The expectation is that Tucker is going to have an expanded role going forward given Rachaad White has been struggling on the ground. It sounds like the two backs will probably split up the workload in the backfield this weekend. That being said, Tucker could have increased fantasy value for the Week 11 contest against the Buffalo Bills. A defensive unit that has struggled to stop opposing backs on the ground. Fantasy managers might be able to trust Tucker as a low-end flex option for this weekend.
